name: How long does it take to install new bathroom flooring?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install new bathroom flooring?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard bathroom flooring installation typically takes between two and four days. The timeline depends heavily on the chosen material, subfloor condition, and drying times. Tiling projects require setting the underlayment, laying tile with thin-set mortar, allowing it to cure overnight, and then grouting and sealing. Luxury vinyl plank installs faster because it does not require mortar curing. If water damage repair, leveling, or custom subfloor framing is discovered once the old floor is pulled, that preparation work can extend the schedule by an additional day.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installing bathroom flooring usually takes two to four days, depending on whether you choose tile or vinyl, subfloor prep needs, and necessary mortar or grout drying times.
